title.narrative: Epifanio de los Santos Avenue Greenways Project

description.narrative: The project aims to improve pedestrian environment in four areas along with Epifanio Delos Santos Avenue (EDSA). The current pedestrian facilities on EDSA is poorly designed and pedestrians are suffered from the unsafe and uncomfortable pedestrian environment. The elevated walkways will be connected to railway stations and help promoting use of public transportation. The project will build a total of 5-kilometers (km) of elevated walkways in four areas, including the construction of new footbridges, replacement or widening of existing footbridges. The elevated walkways will be covered to protect pedestrians from sunlight and rains. Elevators will be attached to the elevated walkways to address the needs of the elderly, persons with disability (PWDs), and people traveling with small children.

Output: Pedestrian walkway built Indicator: A 5-km of elevated walkways constructed or improved around EDSA (2020 baseline: Not applicable) Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: As of 31 December 2025, the total time elapsed for this project is 166% with zero contract awards and disbursements.
NEDA Resubmission (a.k.a. Project Restructuring). During the High Level Portfolio Review Mission on 16 July 2024, PPDO mentioned that EGP will request NEDA approval for a change in implementation timeline and minimal change in scope with no change in cost. As a way forward, DOTr/PPDO to expedite the review of the letter and attachments for the NEDA submission.
Proposed Loan Validity Extension. The Loan Validity is proposed to be extended up to December 2028, covering the one year Defects Liability Period post-construction. However, a 3-month temporary extension request was approved, up to 30 September 2024.
Budget Allocation. EGP has been allocated PHP774.97 million from the GAA 2023. PHP 365.87 million (47.21%) has been obligated for right-of-way payments, with PHP21.84 million (2.82%) already disbursed. GAA 2023 has been extended to December 2024. EGP has no allotment in the NEP 2025.
Updated Implementation Timeline. The construction period is anticipated to start in December 2025 and will end in December 2027 (i.e., 25 months period). This includes construction of footbridge structures, lifts and lift towers, reinstatement of footpaths, underground utility diversion and fencing of footpaths, noting that the one-year defects notification period is not included in the 25 months.
Procurement Progress. Both packages are scheduled for publication in 4Q 2024, with awards expected in October 2025 for Civil Works (CW) Packages and May 2025 for General Consultant (GC). The Project Procurement Management Plan (PPMP) for the GC has been submitted to the Centralized Bids and Awards Committee (CBAC) through Procurement Management Service (ProcMS) on 4 September 2024. The PPMP for CW will be submitted to CBAC through ProcMS within this week. Reason for not issuing General Consultant EoI and the CW package. The Finance Department of DOTr is on the BAC and they would not permit the procurements to start without budget commitments.
Right-of-Way Acquisition. The DOTr has signed four out of nine (4/9) Deeds of Absolute Sale for negotiated sales and is currently completing the documentary requirements for payment. For expropriation proceedings, eight out of twelve (8/12) cases have been endorsed to the Office of the Solicitor General. The remaining three (3) lots under the Right of Way Usage Agreement are currently in process for completion of the documentary requirements. On land acquisition, 73.61% of public and private lands have been acquired by DOTr. The ROW acquisition is expected to be completed by December 2025.
Utility Relocation. Ten out of sixteen (10/16) MOAs have been signed. Maynilad has completed their relocation work at Taft and Balintawak Stations, while Philcom has completed their work at Taft, Guadalupe, and Balintawak Stations. Other project-affected utilities are now being relocated in all stations. Actual relocation work progress is at 18.80%. Data Source: Project completion report of DOTr; pedestrian interview survey deployed during feasibility study and again at project completion
